description_en: Revokes the permissions that allow a transit router to connect to a cross-account network instance
description_zh: 调用RevokeInstanceFromTransitRouter接口取消转发路由器实例连接跨账号网络实例的权限
kebab_example: aliyun cbn revoke-instance-from-transit-router --cen-id cen-44m0p68spvlrqq0000 --instance-id vpc-bp1h8vbrbcgohcju50000 --instance-type VPC --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --cen-owner-id 1250123456123456 --region cn-hangzhou
name: RevokeInstanceFromTransitRouter

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Cloud Enterprise Network (CEN) instance to which the transit router belongs
parameters.help_zh: 转发路由器实例所属的云企业网实例ID
parameters.name: cen_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of the network instance. Valid values:

VPC: VPC instance.
ExpressConnect: VBR instance.
VPN: IPsec connection.
ECR: ECR instance
parameters.help_zh:
网络实例的类型。取值：

VPC：表示VPC实例。
ExpressConnect：表示VBR实例。
VPN：表示IPsec连接。
ECR：表示ECR实例
parameters.name: instance_type

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the network instance.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/132080.html operation to query region IDs
parameters.help_zh:
网络实例所属的地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/132080.html接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account to which the CEN instance belongs
parameters.help_zh: 云企业网实例所属的阿里云账号（主账号）ID
parameters.name: cen_owner_id
